verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own site directly claims built-in task delegation: "Delegate any task" to a Super Agent that "Works 24/7". It also lists built-in specialized agents (Codegen Agent, Triage Agent), lets users "Build your own agent", and describes Brain² as seeing tasks, docs, and conversations in real time. The external MCP server is not a built-in assistant and is not credited here. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how delegation works (assignment flow, scope of actions, review/approval), and any independent or hands-on corroboration that agents complete delegated tasks.
